Slender-billed Vulture ( Gyps tenuirostris , Accipitridae , Accipitriformes ) in Kaziranga National Park , Assam, India.
A large, dark vulture with broad wings and a long, bare neck. Found in plains, grasslands, and open forests, often gathering in large flocks at carcasses. Now a fairly rare species.
